items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown select on Base UI Select: square trigger, portal popup, rows with a dark left-to-right fill wipe, arrow cursor, square bullet and thin rules; groups, separators and disabled items.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem (plus SelectGroup, SelectGroupLabel, SelectSeparator). Pass `items` to Select so the closed trigger can show the selected label. Disabled items stay keyboard-highlightable (Base UI behaviour) but cannot be chosen. Popup uses yorha-pop; optional SelectArrow, SelectBackdrop and SelectLabel parts; the list scrolls inside the popup with scroll arrows. Reduced motion is opacity-only, off is instant.
